description:
Third public release: Material Capsule support and the Pro unlock.

## Added
- **Unlock Pro features** (Material Capsule): the Pro/Premium entitlement is forced to active, so gestures, widgets, card colours, the full mode player and app search work without a Play purchase. Billing (Play Billing 9.1.0) is left untouched.
- **Disable Firebase Analytics tracking** (Material Capsule): the documented Firebase manifest switches plus removal of the advertising-ID / Privacy-Sandbox permissions.
- **Material Capsule** support: com.pryshedko.mtisland 17.3 (versionCode 173), XAPK, arm64-v8a.

## Changed
- The PairIP patch is shared by both apps now.
- The bundle integration test verifies the Pro patch structurally in the patched DEX (both emit sites pass Boolean.TRUE, the one-shot read returns true).

## Patches
- **Remove home screen ads** - blocks the AdMob banner on the home screen (Memorize Pi Digits).
- **Remove cross-promotion (Prime Button and game icons)** - removes the Prime Button and the six side-panel game icons (Memorize Pi Digits).
- **Disable Firebase Analytics tracking** - no analytics event leaves the device (Material Capsule).
- **Unlock Pro features** - Pro works without a purchase (Material Capsule).
- **Bypass PairIP license check** - needed for a sideloaded install (both apps).

**Targets:** com.unknownprojectx.pi 11.01 (11010) and com.pryshedko.mtisland 17.3 (173), XAPK, arm64-v8a

## Note on the Pro patch
This release contains a paywall bypass. Distributing it may be unlawful in some jurisdictions (for example 95a UrhG in Germany) and may violate the app store terms. Use at your own risk.

## Install as a Morphe source
https://morphe.software/add-source?gitlab=JoPatches/jo-patches

## Install note: Play Protect
Material Capsule declares an accessibility service and a notification listener. Google hard-blocks such an APK (dialog with only OK) when it is installed from an internet-sideloading source - a browser, a messaging app or a file manager: https://developers.google.com/android/play-protect/warning-dev-guidance

Install it from Morphe instead. Morphe's SessionInstaller stages the APK as PackageInstaller.PACKAGE_SOURCE_LOCAL_FILE, not as an internet download, so the block never applies and Play Protect stays enabled:
1. Morphe -> Settings -> Installation -> system installer, "After patching" = Install automatically (or Ask).
2. Patch the XAPK in Morphe and tap Install there.
3. Do not open the finished APK from Chrome/Downloads/Files.

Fallbacks for an APK that is already on the device: adb install -r -d <file>.apk, temporarily disabling "Scan apps with Play Protect", or a root/mount installer. Signing key and package name are irrelevant to this rule.

patches.name: Bypass PairIP license check
patches.description: Disables the Play PairIP license check that forces a re-signed build to the Play Store on launch. Required for a sideloaded (non-root) install of the patched APK.

patches.name: Disable Firebase Analytics tracking
patches.description: Deactivates Google Analytics for Firebase through the documented manifest switches, so no analytics event is uploaded, and removes the advertising-ID / Privacy-Sandbox permissions. No app feature is changed.

patches.name: Unlock Pro features
patches.description: Forces the Pro/Premium entitlement to active, so every locked feature (gestures, widgets, card colours, full mode player, app search, ...) works without a Play purchase. The billing code is left untouched.

patches.name: Bypass PairIP license check
patches.description: Disables the Play PairIP license check that forces a re-signed build to the Play Store on launch. Required for a sideloaded (non-root) install of the patched APK.

patches.name: Remove cross-promotion (Prime Button and game icons)
patches.description: Removes the "Prime Button" and the six side-panel game icons from the Unity menu scenes (data.unity3d). The objects are deactivated and scaled to zero, so the menu scripts cannot bring them back at runtime. AdMob banner, interstitial and rewarded ads are not touched.

patches.name: Remove home screen ads
patches.description: Removes the AdMob banner ads shown on the home screen pages. All Java entry points (DeviceManager, AdManager, AdmobAdapter) are blocked, so no banner view is created or shown. The area simply shows the black Unity background afterwards.
